_meta.purpose: Mandatory BIS certification requirements, mapped to standards in the corpus.
_meta.method: Read from the BIS Scheme I (ISI Mark) product list and cross-checked against Quality Control Order notifications. No scraping: pages were read, not crawled.
_meta.coverage_warning: The BIS Scheme I list contains ~221 product rows and could only be read in sections. A standard recorded here as 'not_listed' was not found in the sections read, which is weaker evidence than a positive match. Treat 'not_listed' as 'not confirmed', never as 'confirmed exempt'.

schemes.ISI: Scheme I. Standard Mark (ISI) required under licence, mandated by a Quality Control Order.
schemes.CRS: Scheme II. Compulsory Registration Scheme, mostly electronics and IT equipment.
schemes.none: Confirmed that no product certification scheme applies (e.g. a code of practice, which specifies how to design or install rather than what to supply).
schemes.not_listed: Not found in the sections of the BIS list that were read. Status unknown.

withdrawn_editions.issue: IS 8112 (43 grade OPC) was withdrawn and merged into IS 269:2015. The two ran concurrently until 30 Oct 2016, after which IS 8112 stood withdrawn. No 2018 edition exists.
